description: Repeated flight delays in Resolute created significant fatigue and alertness strain — crew had to remain constantly ready to depart, sometimes with only 30 minutes' notice.
response: The Commander managed expectations explicitly and redirected focus to preparedness tasks.
lesson: Brief the crew before Resolute arrival that weather delays are normal. Give crew agency to relax during confirmed wait periods — constant alertness is exhausting. Structure the day: morning weather check, go/no-go by a fixed time, then planned activity.
pattern_tag: Resolute delay fatigue and alertness strain
